advice: Abstain. The supplied source shows that the four ZA.S tiles already hold the four parts of each output block and receive one ordered FP32 FMOPA update per K step. The panel32 helper has the same four-tile structure. The wrapper only selects disjoint output row bands; it cannot remap tile reuse without changing the generated kernel body or its layout/traversal. No distinct legal tile-reuse experiment is supported by the supplied evidence.
risks: The panel32 wrapper was already measured and did not pass promotion gates. Its results do not show whether a tile remapping would help. Do not infer performance from the tile count or attribute those joint scores to this role. Any future body or layout change needs full-GEMM correctness checks and fresh paired controls with the fixed benchmark settings.
